internal.title: Incident Resolved: Checkout Service Errors Due to Payment Service Fault Injection
internal.body:
At 10:52 UTC, we received alerts for high error rates in the checkout service. Diagnosis identified a 100% error rate in the payment service caused by an error injection fault. A mitigation action was proposed and approved to disable the payment failure flag. This action was executed at 11:12 UTC, resulting in immediate recovery of the checkout service error rates to normal levels. The root cause was confirmed as an error injection in the payment service. No configuration or flag changes were involved in the checkout service itself. The incident was resolved promptly with no lasting impact on other services.

Timeline:
- 10:52 UTC: Alert received for high checkout errors
- 11:12 UTC: Diagnosis confirmed payment service error injection
- 11:12 UTC: Flag disabling action approved and executed
- 11:12 UTC: Service error rates returned to normal

Next steps include reviewing error injection controls in the payment service to prevent recurrence.

external.title: Some checkouts failed due to payment service issue
external.body: Between 10:52 and 11:12 UTC, some customers experienced issues completing checkout due to a fault in the payment processing service. The issue was quickly identified and resolved by our operations team, restoring normal service. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and are taking steps to prevent similar issues in the future.
